info.title: Inurum Enterprise DashCam & Telematics API (TruckerCloud Certified)
info.description: Production-grade RESTful API backend for Inurum DashCam Fleet Telematics & Video Retrieval. Features validated 17-character VIN mapping, explicit ECU/GPS odometer provenance tracking, native JT/T 808 GPS telemetry, JT/T 1078 dual-camera live streaming, on-demand SD card retrieval (0x9205/0x9201), ADAS/DMS safety incident evidence, and a dedicated TruckerCloud integration namespace (`/api/v1/integrations/truckercloud/*`).
